$comment: Pass as response_schema with response_mime_type=application/json. One request scores a batch of windows; the API maps results back by window_idx.

window_idx.description: Echo of the index given in the prompt

valence.description: Overall emotional tone, -1 very negative to 1 very positive

arousal.description: Intensity or energy, 0 calm to 1 frantic

tension.description: Suspense or anticipation, independent of valence

summary.description: One sentence, present tense, no spoilers beyond this window, max 20 words
